data.content:
No unverified absence is converted into a confirmed injury or suspension for this preview. Cape Verde's World Cup-experienced core through Vozinha, Pina and Ryan Mendes remains central to the side's plans after the Mali defeat, with no reported fitness concern for that group. Rwanda can retain the midfield balance around Djihad Bizimana and Bonheur Mugisha that helped them beat Liberia, and no specific Matchday 2 absence has been confirmed in the available reporting for either side. Projected lineups, not confirmed — Rwanda: Fiacre Ntwari; Emery Bayisenge, Emery Byiringiro, Aristide Niyomugabo, Ange Mutsinzi; Bonheur Mugisha, Djihad Bizimana; Muhadjiri Hakizimana, Yannick Mukunzi, Bienvenue Biramahire; Jojea Kwizera.
